A Two Minute Morning Skin Routine to Use Before 9 AM

Most skincare routines fail for one reason: they were designed for people with empty mornings. If your first call is at nine and your day is stacked after that, a routine survives only if it is fast, simple and impossible to get wrong.
This is the full routine. It takes two minutes and has four steps.
The routine
0:00 — Rinse or cleanse.
Lukewarm water is enough for most mornings; use a gentle cleanser if your skin runs oily.
0:30 — Serum.
2–4 pumps of PDRN Brightening Serum, pressed over face and neck on clean, dry skin. It absorbs fast — no greasy residue, no waiting around.
1:30 — Moisturizer.
A thin layer to keep water in the skin after the serum.
1:45 — Sunscreen.
Every day. Sunscreen protects the skin during the day.
Why the order matters

Apply products from thinnest to thickest. A serum is water based and concentrated, so it goes on first, directly on the skin. Its ingredients are PDRN, acetyl hexapeptide 8, sodium hyaluronate and panthenol. Cream and sunscreen go on top and cover the skin.
Use the same routine every day
A routine only helps if you continue it. The serum is the main step in this morning routine. Use one bottle, twice a day. The Tava app can store reminders and your plan in one place.
The routine takes two minutes. After that, start your work day.
